description_en: Queries the details of a specified Resource Access Management (RAM) user
description_zh: 查询指定的RAM用户的详细信息
name: GetUser

parameters.help_en:
The logon Resource Access Management (RAM) user.

The format is `<username>@<AccountAlias>.onaliyun.com`, where `<username>` is the Resource Access Management (RAM) user and `<AccountAlias>.onaliyun.com` is the default domain name. 

The `UserPrincipalName` must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), hyphens (-), and underscores (_). The `<username>` must be 1 to 64 characters in length.

You must specify exactly one of the following parameters: `UserPrincipalName`, `UserId`, and `UserAccessKeyId`
parameters.help_zh:
RAM用户的登录名称。

格式为`<username>@<AccountAlias>.onaliyun.com`，其中`<username>`为RAM用户名称，`<AccountAlias>.onaliyun.com`为默认域名。 

`UserPrincipalName`长度为`1~128`个字符，可包含英文字母、数字、半角句号（.）、短划线（-）和下划线（_）。其中`<username>`的长度为`1~64`个字符。

必须指定 `UserPrincipalName`、`UserId`和`UserAccessKeyId`三个参数中的一个参数，但不能同时指定
parameters.name: user_principal_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user.
You must specify exactly one of the following parameters: `UserPrincipalName`, `UserId`, and `UserAccessKeyId`
parameters.help_zh:
RAM用户ID。
必须指定 `UserPrincipalName`、`UserId`和`UserAccessKeyId`三个参数中的一个参数，但不能同时指定
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en:
The AccessKey ID of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user.
You must specify exactly one of the following parameters: `UserPrincipalName`, `UserId`, and `UserAccessKeyId`
parameters.help_zh:
RAM用户的访问密钥ID。
必须指定 `UserPrincipalName`、`UserId`和`UserAccessKeyId`三个参数中的一个参数，但不能同时指定
parameters.name: user_access_key_id

User.description_en: The information about the Resource Access Management (RAM) user

Comments.example: This is a cloud computing engineer.

CreateDate.description_en:
The time when the Resource Access Management (RAM) user was created.

The format is RFC 3339 (UTC). Example: 2020-10-12T09:12:00Z
CreateDate.description_zh:
RAM用户的创建时间。

格式：RFC 3339（UTC），例如：2020-10-12T09:12:00Z

DisplayName.description_en: The display name of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user

Email.description_en:
The electron mailbox of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user.
This parameter applies only to the China site
Email.description_zh:
RAM用户的电子邮箱。
该参数仅适用于中国站

LastLoginDate.description_en:
The time of the last console logon of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user.

The format is RFC 3339 (UTC). Example: 2020-10-12T09:12:00Z
LastLoginDate.description_zh:
RAM用户最近一次登录控制台的时间。

格式：RFC 3339（UTC），例如：2020-10-12T09:12:00Z

MobilePhone.description_en:
The mobile phone number of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user.
This parameter applies only to the China site
MobilePhone.description_zh:
RAM用户的手机号码。
该参数仅适用于中国站

ProvisionType.description_en:
The synchronization type. Valid values:
Manual: The Resource Access Management (RAM) user is manually created in RAM.
SCIM: The Resource Access Management (RAM) user is created through synchronization via the System for Cross-domain Identity Management protocol.
CloudSSO: The user is created through CloudSSO synchronization
ProvisionType.description_zh:
同步类型。取值：
Manual：在RAM中手动创建的RAM用户。
SCIM：通过SCIM协议同步创建的RAM用户。
CloudSSO：通过云SSO同步创建的用户

UpdateDate.description_en:
The time when the Resource Access Management (RAM) user was updated.

The format is RFC 3339 (UTC). Example: 2020-10-13T07:39:22Z
UpdateDate.description_zh:
RAM用户的更新时间。

格式：RFC 3339（UTC），例如：2020-10-13T07:39:22Z

UserId.description_en: The ID of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user

UserName.description_en: The name of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user, which is the prefix of the logon name
UserName.description_zh: RAM用户的名称，即登录名的前缀

UserPrincipalName.description_en: The logon name of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user
